    "models/alexnet.py": {
      "description": "AlexNet 模型定义。5 个卷积层(conv1-conv5) + 3 个全连接层(fc6-fc8)，fc8 输出 38 类。conv1/conv2 后接 LRN + MaxPool，conv5 后接 MaxPool，fc6/fc7 有 Dropout(0.5)，所有前 7 层用 ReLU。支持 ImageNet 预训练权重加载并重置 fc8 层。",

      "methods": [
        "__init__(num_classes=38, pretrained=True)",
        "forward(x) -> tensor",
        "reset_classifier(num_classes) -> None # 重置 fc8 输出层为 num_classes 类",

        "get_features(x) -> tensor # 返回 fc7 层输出，用于特征提取"
      ],
      "modules_layers": {
        "conv1": "Conv2d(3, 64, kernel_size=11, stride=4, padding=2) + ReLU + LocalResponseNorm(size=5) + MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2)",
        "conv2": "Conv2d(64, 192, kernel_size=5, padding=2) + ReLU + LocalResponseNorm(size=5) + MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2)",
        "conv3": "Conv2d(192, 384, kernel_size=3, padding=1) + ReLU",
        "conv4": "Conv2d(384, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1) + ReLU",
        "conv5": "Conv2d(256, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1) + ReLU + MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2)",
        "fc6": "Linear(256*6*6, 4096) + ReLU + Dropout(0.5)",
        "fc7": "Linear(4096, 4096) + ReLU + Dropout(0.5)",
        "fc8": "Linear(4096, num_classes=38)"
      },
      "pretrained_handling": "torchvision.models.alexnet(pretrained=True) 或手动加载权重；仅重置 fc8 参数为随机初始化",
      "notes": "约 6000 万参数；输入 224x224 (torchvision默认) 或 256x256 需调整 fc6 输入维度；论文使用 256x256 输入",
      "pseudocode": "class AlexNet(nn.Module):\n  __init__(num_classes, pretrained):\n    self.features = Sequential(conv1,relu1,norm1,pool1,conv2,relu2,norm2,pool2,conv3,relu3,conv4,relu4,conv5,relu5,pool5)\n    self.classifier = Sequential(fc6,relu6,drop6,fc7,relu7,drop7,fc8)\n    if pretrained: load ImageNet weights for features & fc6/fc7; randomly init fc8\n  forward(x): x = self.features(x); x = flatten(x); x = self.classifier(x); return x\n  reset_classifier: replace last Linear layer with Linear(in_features, num_classes)"
    },
    "models/googlenet.py": {
      "description": "GoogLeNet(Inception v1) 模型定义。22 层深度网络，使用 9 个 Inception 模块。每个 Inception 模块含并行的 1x1, 3x3, 5x5 卷积和 MaxPool 分支，3x3/5x5 前加 1x1 降维，MaxPool 后加 1x1 降维，最终 Concatenate。含辅助分类器 loss2/loss3，训练时用权重 0.3 的辅助损失。支持 ImageNet 预训练权重，重置所有分类器为 38 类。",
      "class": "GoogLeNet",
      "parent_class": "torch.nn.Module",
      "methods": [
        "__init__(num_classes=38, pretrained=True, aux_logits=True)",

        "reset_classifier(num_classes) -> None # 重置 loss1/loss2/loss3 分类器",
        "load_pretrained_weights(weights_path=None) -> None # 加载 ImageNet 预训练权重"
      ],
      "inner_classes": {
        "Inception": {
          "methods": ["__init__(in_channels, ch1x1, ch3x1, ch3x3, ch5x1, ch5x5, pool_proj)", "forward(x)"],
          "branches": "conv1x1, conv3x3(含1x1降维), conv5x5(含1x1降维), maxpool+1x1",
          "concat_axis": 1
        },
        "InceptionAux": {
          "methods": ["__init__(in_channels, num_classes)", "forward(x)"],
          "description": "辅助分类器：AveragePool + Conv1x1 + Linear + ReLU + Dropout(0.7) + Linear"
        }
      },
      "architecture_detail": {
        "conv1": "Conv2d(3, 64, kernel_size=7, stride=2, padding=3) + ReLU + MaxPool2d(3, stride=2)",

        "inception3a": "Inception(192, 64, 96, 128, 16, 32, 32)",
        "inception3b": "Inception(256, 128, 128, 192, 32, 96, 64) + MaxPool2d(3, stride=2)",
        "inception4a": "Inception(480, 192, 96, 208, 16, 48, 64) [aux1]",
        "inception4b": "Inception(512, 160, 112, 224, 24, 64, 64)",
        "inception4c": "Inception(512, 128, 128, 256, 24, 64, 64)",

        "inception4e": "Inception(528, 256, 160, 320, 32, 128, 128) + MaxPool2d(3, stride=2)",
        "inception5a": "Inception(832, 256, 160, 320, 32, 128, 128)",

      },
      "pretrained_handling": "torchvision.models.googlenet(pretrained=True) 或手动加载；重置 aux1/aux2/main classifier 最后一层为 38 类",
      "notes": "约 500 万参数；22 层深度；训练时输出 main_loss + 0.3*aux2_loss + 0.3*aux1_loss",
      "pseudocode": "class GoogLeNet(nn.Module):\n  __init__:\n    self.conv1, self.conv2 = ... (标准 stem)\n    self.inception3a, inception3b, inception4a~e, inception5a~b = Inception(...)\n    self.aux1 = InceptionAux(512, num_classes) from inception4a\n    self.aux2 = InceptionAux(528, num_classes) from inception4d\n    self.avgpool = AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)\n    self.dropout = Dropout(0.4)\n    self.fc = Linear(1024, num_classes)\n    if pretrained: load imagenet weights, reset fc and aux classifiers\n  forward(x): conv1->conv2->inception3a->3b->4a->4b->4c->4d->4e->5a->5b->avgpool->dropout->fc\n    if training and aux_logits: also compute aux1(x from 4a), aux2(x from 4d)\n  reset_classifier: reset fc, loss2_classifier2, loss3_classifier2 to num_classes"
    },

      "training_details": {
        "loss_function": "nn.CrossEntropyLoss() (主损失); GoogLeNet 辅助分类器也用 CrossEntropyLoss, 权重 0.3",
        "optimizer": "SGD(lr=0.005, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0005)",
        "scheduler": "StepLR(optimizer, step_size=10, gamma=0.1)",
        "epochs": 30,
        "batch_size_alexnet": 100,
        "batch_size_googlenet": 24,
        "log_interval": "每个 batch 或每 10 个 batch 记录 loss",
        "checkpoint": "每个 epoch 结束保存，根据 validation accuracy 保存 best"
      },
      "pseudocode": "def main(config_path):\n  config = yaml.safe_load(open(config_path))\n  set_seed(config.seed)\n  device = torch.device(config.training.device)\n  train_loader, test_loader = create_dataloaders(config)\n  model = build_model(config.model)  # AlexNet or GoogLeNet\n  criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n  optimizer = SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.005, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0005)\n  scheduler = StepLR(optimizer, step_size=10, gamma=0.1)\n  best_acc = 0\n  for epoch in range(30):\n    train_metrics = train_epoch(model, train_loader, criterion, optimizer, device, epoch)\n    val_metrics = validate(model, test_loader, criterion, device)\n    scheduler.step()\n    if val_metrics.acc > best_acc: save best checkpoint\n    log(epoch, train_metrics, val_metrics)\n  return final_metrics\n\ndef train_epoch(...):\n  model.train()\n  for batch_idx, (images, labels) in enumerate(train_loader):\n    images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)\n    optimizer.zero_grad()\n    outputs = model(images)\n    if isinstance(outputs, tuple) and training:  # GoogLeNet with aux\n      main_out, aux1_out, aux2_out = outputs\n      loss = criterion(main_out, labels) + 0.3*criterion(aux1_out, labels) + 0.3*criterion(aux2_out, labels)\n    else:\n      loss = criterion(outputs, labels)\n    loss.backward()\n    optimizer.step()\n  compute_metrics(all_preds, all_labels)\n\ndef validate(...):\n  model.eval()\n  with torch.no_grad():\n    for images, labels in val_loader:\n      outputs = model(images)\n      compute predictions\n  return metrics from utils.metrics"

    "utils/metrics.py": {
      "description": "评估指标计算工具。实现总体准确率、mean F1 score、mean precision、mean recall 以及 per-class 指标。使用 scikit-learn 的 classification_report 或手动实现精确度/召回率/F1 计算。支持批量指标汇总。",
      "functions": [
        "compute_accuracy(y_true, y_pred) -> float",
        "compute_mean_f1(y_true, y_pred, num_classes=38) -> float",
        "compute_mean_precision(y_true, y_pred, num_classes=38) -> float",
        "compute_mean_recall(y_true, y_pred, num_classes=38) -> float",
        "compute_per_class_metrics(y_true, y_pred, num_classes=38) -> dict",
        "compute_confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred, num_classes=38) -> numpy.ndarray",
        "compute_all_metrics(y_true, y_pred, num_classes=38) -> dict",
        "format_metrics(metrics) -> str"
      ],
      "uses": ["numpy", "sklearn.metrics (f1_score, precision_score, recall_score, accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, classification_report)", "torch"],
      "metrics_details": {
        "accuracy": "total_correct / total_samples",
        "mean_f1": "unweighted mean of per-class F1 scores: F1 = 2*P*R/(P+R)",
        "mean_precision": "unweighted mean of per-class precision",
        "mean_recall": "unweighted mean of per-class recall",
        "per_class": "每个类别的 precision, recall, f1, support",
        "zero_division": "对于没有预测样本的类别，precision/recall/f1 设为 0"
      },
      "pseudocode": "def compute_all_metrics(y_true, y_pred, num_classes):\n  accuracy = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)\n  precision_per_class = precision_score(y_true, y_pred, average=None, zero_division=0, labels=range(num_classes))\n  recall_per_class = recall_score(y_true, y_pred, average=None, zero_division=0, labels=range(num_classes))\n  f1_per_class = f1_score(y_true, y_pred, average=None, zero_division=0, labels=range(num_classes))\n  mean_f1 = np.mean(f1_per_class)\n  mean_precision = np.mean(precision_per_class)\n  mean_recall = np.mean(recall_per_class)\n  cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred, labels=range(num_classes))\n  return {'accuracy': accuracy, 'mean_f1': mean_f1, 'mean_precision': mean_precision, 'mean_recall': mean_recall, 'per_class': ..., 'confusion_matrix': cm}"
    },
